rationale: C4 is an interference check on the executed edge-level arms, not a property of the target set.
C4 cannot be observed before cells exist; making it a pre-freeze admissibility gate would require either a circular freeze or an unregistered diagnostic run.
A post-freeze gate preserves the precommitted thresholds and blindness: the result is assembled only after the frozen cells run.
C1 uses the same C4-expanded denominator and is scored in the same post-freeze result assembly.
sequence: The owner freezes the representative target manifest in a separate act.
The owner issues the dated grant; the planned cells run.
a1_result.assemble scores C1 and C4 from the cell parts.
A failed C4 or unmeasurable C4 invalidates the A1 result before any claim is read.
void_condition: C4_no_interference fails if any measurable non-target A, K or Y neighbour delta exceeds 0.05, or if the non-target stream is unmeasurable. The A1 run is VOID; no causal, capability or transfer claim may be read from it.
c1_relationship: C1 and C4 are both post-freeze result gates. C1 remains the primary preservation gate; C4 supplies the non-target denominator and an interference veto.
adopted_extension: docs/A1-C1-C4-VOID-GATE.md is ADOPTED — BINDING FOR A1 (2026-11-14) and consolidates C1 and C4 into one post-freeze validity decision, together with the 60-row denominator floor. This C4-only record remains the historical C4 trigger.
does_not_authorize: any A1 result or causal claim
freeze_effect: This decision removes C4 from the pre-freeze blocker set. The targets remain draft and the manifest remains unfrozen because no separate owner target freeze act has been recorded.
not_evidence: A gate-order decision only. No cell has run; this is not an A1 result, grant or capability claim.
